title: Congreso, 24 Nov 2022 (session 218): votes on Ley 38/2022 (creates the solidarity tax on large fortunes)
notes: 39 amendment votes and a technical correction found for the bill; the final vote on the dictamen was not located in the open data. Senate approved on 21 Dec 2022. R006: a press report (Moncloa.com) lists the groups voting for the bill on 24 Nov 2022: 186 deputies of PSOE, Unidas Podemos, ERC, Bildu, Junts, Más País-Equo, Compromís, CC, CUP and BNG, in a public roll call by name. Individual votes not yet read. R007: the Congreso open data for 24 Nov 2022 (sessions 217 and 218, 499 votes) holds 39 amendment votes and a technical correction for this bill but no separate vote of the whole law (186-152-10), so individual votes cannot be harvested from it; the Senate vote (139-106-12) has no per-senator list in the sources found.
